lines.en: Come here. Let's look at the days of this month.
lines.ko: 이리 와요. 이번 달 날짜를 같이 봐요.

lines.en: Grandma, when is my big day this year?
lines.ko: 할머니, 올해 제 특별한 날은 언제예요?

lines.en: It is this Saturday. Five days from today.
lines.ko: 이번 주 토요일이에요. 오늘부터 닷새 뒤예요.

lines.en: Last year it was on a Sunday.
Yes, and we ate cake all day last year.
lines.ko: 맞아요, 작년에는 하루 종일 케이크를 먹었어요.

lines.en: Will you make a cake this year too?
Sure. I will make it on Friday.
What day is it today?
Today is Monday. Five more days.
Thank you, Grandma. I can't wait!
Hello. I want to see the doctor this week.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이번 주에 진료를 받고 싶어요.

lines.en: Sure. Which day is good for you?
Is Tuesday open?
Tuesday is full. How about Wednesday or Thursday?
lines.ko: 화요일은 다 찼어요. 수요일이나 목요일은 어때요?

lines.en: Thursday is fine. What time?
Ten in the morning. Is that fine?
Yes. I came last month on a Monday.
I see it here. The doctor will see you Thursday.
lines.ko: 여기 있네요. 의사 선생님이 목요일에 봐 주실 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you so much. See you on Thursday.
We will call you on Wednesday.
